explanations.content: When Java encounters a `break` statement inside a loop, it exits the loop immediately, ignoring any remaining statements in the current iteration. When it encounters a `continue` statement, it skips the remaining statements of the current iteration and jumps to the next iteration by moving control to the beginning of the loop.

procedures.procedure_name: Handle user input with break and continue statements
steps: If the input equals "quit", execute a `break` statement to terminate the loop.
Else if the input equals "pass", execute a `continue` statement to skip the rest of the loop body and start the next iteration.
